days.title: Northern Lakes and Tributaries
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: lago di Alserio
stops.detail: In the north of the Regional Park, there are two lakes entirely included within the park: Lake Alserio and Lake Pusiano, into which the Lambro first flows as the Lambrone, then exits and continues its path until it meets the Po at Orio Litta.

stops.name: Rio Pegorino
stops.detail: It includes numerous urban areas, but especially wooded areas that emerge along the Lambro and its tributaries Bevere and Rii (Rio Pegorino, Rio Cantalupo).
